cards.name: Shining Brigade - Loving Division

effects.printed_clause: During the Main Phase: You can target 1 "Shining Brigade" card in your GY; banish it, and if you do, Special Summon this card from your hand or GY. You can only use this effect of "Shining Brigade - Loving Division" once per turn. A "Shining Brigade" monster that has this card as material gains the following effect.
effects.lua_implementation: A hand/GY Ignition Effect inherently limits activation to the controller Main Phase, targets an archetype GY card, removes it, then Special Summons the related handler; id is a hard limit.

official_references.official_effect_text: If this card is sent to the GY: [b]Banish[/b] 1 Level 7 or higher LIGHT or DARK Dragon monster from your Deck. If this card is banished from your GY: [b]You can[/b] add the monster banished by this card's effect to your hand.

If your opponent controls 2 or more monsters, [b]you can[/b] Special Summon this card (from your hand). [b]You can[/b] only Special Summon "Moon Gardna" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b] this way. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned [b]and[/b] your opponent controls a monster: [b]You can[/b] [b]target[/b] 1 Level 4 LIGHT monster in your GY, except "Moon Gardna"; add it to your hand. [b]You can[/b] only use this effect of "Moon Gardna" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b].

effects.printed_clause:
During the Main Phase: You can target 1 "Shining Brigade" card in your GY; banish it, and if you do, Special Summon this card from your hand or GY. You can only use this effect of "Shining Brigade - Loving Division" once per turn. A "Shining Brigade" monster that has this card as material gains the following effect.
● Once per turn: You can Set 1 "Shining Brigade" Trap from your Deck, GY, or banishment (that Set card can be activated this turn).
effects.lua_implementation: An EFFECT_TYPE_XMATERIAL Ignition Effect with soft count Sets one legal Trap from all three locations and grants EFFECT_TRAP_ACT_IN_SET_TURN.

official_references.official_effect_text:
If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect: [b]You can[/b] [b]target[/b] 1 "Zoodiac" monster in your GY, except "Zoodiac Ramram"; Special Summon it. An Xyz Monster whose original Type is Beast-Warrior [b]and[/b] has this card as material gains this effect.
● [b]When[/b] your opponent activates a Trap Card or effect that targets this card ([b]Quick Effect[/b]): [b]You can[/b] detach 1 material from this card; [b]negate[/b] the activation.

[b]Banish[/b] 1 Normal Trap from your Deck, except "Trap Trick", [b]and if you do[/b], Set 1 card with the same name directly from your Deck. It can be activated this turn. [b]You can[/b] only activate 1 Trap Card for the rest of this turn after this card resolves. [b]You can[/b] only activate 1 "Trap Trick" [b]per turn[/b].
